display_long_description:
"Whimsy meets Wisdom"

There’s a secret world beneath every technology product that pulses with untold stories—midnight breakthroughs, surprise collaborations, the first whispers of burnout, and the electric moments when everything clicks. **Factotum is your back-stage pass into this world.**

Step inside and marvel at the hidden choreography of collaboration that powers our world. Watch efforts flow into streams of value that merge into meaningful outcomes. Feel the tidal rhythm of releases, the pileups when things are unbalanced, and the triumph when sentiment is high. Discover legendary public projects that power the device you’re reading this on, or unearth latent information in your own projects.

It's part **detective story**, part **behind-the-scenes documentary**, part **mesmerizing spectacle** — your invitation to the greatest show in human ingenuity that usually goes unseen. Absorb the emergent outcomes of humans learning to work together—the real stories behind the worldwide creative forces that has built our digital future for generations.

**Free to explore**, **no subscriptions required**, and **no private data ever gets sent to us**, thanks to the power of Meta Quest.

Ready to witness what elite builders see when they close their eyes? The symphony is already playing.
